rows.en: Yes, let's come again.

(Today I came to the artificial island
with Miyuki again.)
Just like my heart!
Sigh... What are you even saying...?

I never thought there'd be such
a steep cliff here~
Whoops, guess we should head home soon.
(Today I came to Griffith Park with Shirakawa!)
The view here at dusk is lovely, isn't it?

You can look out over the whole city, too.
It's a nice park, huh...

...Would you mind if I took in the view
for a while?
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki asking the player; answered 'Of course.'

rows.en:
Thank you.
You weren't bored, were you?
rows.notes: x4, Miyuki, both genders and visits.

rows.en:
Nope. I was watching a pretty girl lost in thought,
so I wasn't bored at all.

...There you go again with your lies...
Please stop joking with a straight face!
I'm not joking, though.
G-geez, I'm not talking to you anymore!
(Today I came to Griffith Park with Miyuki.)
The view here at dusk is lovely, isn't it...

You can look out over the whole city...
What a nice park...

I was watching a pretty girl lost in thought,
so I wasn't bored at all~

I'm not joking.
I really think you're beautiful and cute, Miyuki.
(...Today was a nice change of pace!)

(Today I came to Griffith Park with Shirakawa
again!)
The air here is always so nice...
The breeze feels nice, huh.
Hey, why don't we take a little walk?
Sure, let's walk.
I had fun walking with you, Shirakawa.

...Isn't it just your sweet talk that's
gotten better lately?
Th-that's not true at all, nope...
(Today I came to Griffith Park with Miyuki again.)
Yeah, let's walk.
I had fun walking with you, Miyuki.
Hmm, I don't think so?
(Today it's EX-Gear training with Shirakawa!)

I'm sorry for making you wait,
\p-kun.
Hehe, you're so kind.
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki (kusu); answers 'don't worry, I just got here'.

rows.en: Huh? N-no, I'm not, really!!
Hehe, well then, shall we go?
Phew, let's take a break.
You're amazing, Shirakawa...

I mean, you fly the EX-Gear so boldly.
You really go all in...
I could never pull that off.

R-really?
I never really thought about it...
Come on, let's give it another go, shall we?
(Today it's EX-Gear training with Miyuki.)

I'm sorry for making you wait,
\p-san.
Well then, shall we go?
You're amazing, Miyuki...

I mean, you fly the EX-Gear so boldly.
You really go all in...
I could never pull that off~
(Today it's EX-Gear training with Shirakawa again!)
Let's do our best again today.
Yeah, let's give it our all!
You're as amazing as ever, Shirakawa...

Your turns are even sharper than before.
I can't fall behind either.

Geez, flattering me won't get you anything,
you know.
Come on, let's try another flight, shall we?
(Today it's EX-Gear training with Miyuki again.)
Heya, Miyuki.
You're as amazing as ever, Miyuki...

Your turns are even sharper than before.
I can't fall behind either.
(Today I came out to Folmo with Shirakawa!)
Where shall we go today?

Let's go see the hippo-cows.
They're super huge.
Are they?
Then let's go take a look.

Those cows make delicious soft serve, you know.
Let's have some on the way home.
rows.notes: x2, player; soft serve as in slice 156.

rows.en: ...All you ever think about is food.
You don't mind it either, do you, Shirakawa?
W-well... that's true, but...
All right, let's go get some soft serve!
(Today I came out to Folmo with Miyuki.)

Let's go see the hippo-cows!
They're super huge~
You don't mind it either, do you, Miyuki?
All right, let's go get some soft serve!
(Today I came out to Folmo with Shirakawa again!)

When you come to Folmo, there's only one place
to hit first, right?
rows.notes: Male; matches the female c11414 in slice 156.

rows.en: Soft serve, right!
Exactly!
Phew, I'm stuffed.

Is it really okay to eat so much soft serve
that you're stuffed?
rows.notes: Miyuki, male scene (casual daijoubu?); as c11416.

rows.en: My stomach's the one part of me that's tough.

uncertain: c11339: 'shibaraku nagametete mo ii desu ka' read as Miyuki asking to stay and take in the sunset view; the player answers 'Of course.'
c11362: female player's 'sonna koto wa nai yo?' rendered 'Hmm, I don't think so?' (denying that only her sweet talk has improved).
